_comment: Links to the AI you use. SHIPPED WITH DEFAULTS so the tool works out of the box.
This is a config file: edit it, add to it, delete from it. Nothing here is compiled in,
nothing is preferred, and the order is alphabetical rather than a ranking.
A cycler is not an AI provider. It must stay useful if every service below disappears —
which is what the local entries are for.
_note_on_urls: Where a service accepts the prompt in the address, {prompt} is substituted and the tab opens
ready. Where it does not, the prompt is copied to your clipboard and you paste it.
Both paths work; neither sends anything through us.

no_ai_at_all.note: Every step can be answered by typing. The cycler asks the question; who or what answers it is not its business.
